_1: Your own Azure application (client) id goes in clientId, below.
_2: Register it yourself at portal.azure.com: personal Microsoft accounts only, public client flows ON, no client secret. Then ask Mojang to approve that application for the Minecraft scopes - until they do, the Minecraft half of the chain will refuse the token.
_3: Do not paste in a client id belonging to another launcher. See auth-config.js for the whole of it.
_4: KESTREL_MSA_CLIENT_ID in the environment overrides this file, and a copy of this file in %APPDATA%/Kestrel overrides the one in the source tree.
_5: Left as it ships, the launcher runs its device-code screen against a local stub and says on screen that nothing was really signed in.
